}

title: Service Account Named with Threat Actor
id: 8a3b45c2-1f56-4b2d-9c1a-7d8e9f0a1b2c
status: experimental
description: Detects creation or use of service accounts with names matching known threat actors.
author: SOC Team
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:

        AccountName|contains:

            - 'apt28'
            - 'fancybear'
    condition: selection
level: high
